# anthropic_workspace_rate_limit (Resource)

Manages a workspace's rate limit overrides for one rate limit group (`/v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/rate_limits/{rate_limit_id}`). Overrides for limiter types not in `limits` are cleared. Destroy clears all of them, and the workspace falls back to the organization limits. A value above the organization limit is stored, but the lower of the two is enforced. Changes take effect within about an hour.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_rate_limits" "models" {
  group_type = "model_group"
}

# Override two limiter types for one rate limit group in a workspace.
# Overrides for limiter types not listed here are cleared.
resource "anthropic_workspace_rate_limit" "team_model_group" {
  workspace_id  = "wrkspc_01EXAMPLE"
  rate_limit_id = data.anthropic_rate_limits.models.rate_limits[0].id
  limits = {
    requests_per_minute     = 100
    input_tokens_per_minute = 50000
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `limits` (Map of Number) Override values keyed by limiter type: `requests_per_minute`, `input_tokens_per_minute`, `input_tokens_per_minute_cache_aware`, `output_tokens_per_minute`, `tokens_per_minute`, `tokens_per_day`, `tool_uses_per_second`, `fast_itpmca`, `fast_otpm`.
- `rate_limit_id` (String) The `id` of the organization rate limit entry to override (from the `anthropic_rate_limits` data source), not the `group_id`.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `<workspace_id>/<rate_limit_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Workspace rate limits are imported by "<workspace_id>/<rate_limit_id>".
terraform import anthropic_workspace_rate_limit.team_model_group wrkspc_01EXAMPLE/rl_01EXAMPLE
```
